$doc: What each line of the world gizmo is drawn in, so the lines and the
shell's legend of them read one look: the frame's marks about the focus
(scene/indicator/frame_gizmo.rs) and the coverage's over the ground
opacity, and dashed where a dashed line draws it: a ring of the frame, a

focus.$doc: The focus and the ground cell it floors to.

forward.$doc: The upright ring facing the screen, and the view's forward on it.

north.$doc: The upright ring through north, and north on it.

coverage.$doc: Over the ground, the eye's windows' squares (layer/terrain/window.rs) where the eye reads each at its zoom, in the order a stretch shared by several takes the last: a drawn square faint under what marks one not drawn.

drawn.$doc: A square present, its cells filled from its own tile.

coarser.$doc: A square still to land, a coarser window's square drawn in its place.

no_tile.$doc: A square past the source: no tile of its own, a tile over it says its ground, and a coarser square stands in for good.

wanted.$doc: A square still to land, nothing drawn in its place.

shard.$doc: A drawn square's shard, the unit the source serves the world in.
